title: Trust store
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management; QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards. HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management: “Ultimately, every Verifier needs to have a list of all public keys it is willing to trust”.

statements.label: Trust store
statements.requirement: Trust material SHALL be held in a trust store that the host fills with DSCs it has obtained, and that returns every trusted DSC matching a kid. The store SHALL do no network or file I/O (STT-GEN-012).
